spacr.gene_measurement_compare.EnergyRef:
A fixed set of control cells every E-statistic is measured against.

:param reference: control cells by dimensions.

``energy(x)`` returns ``(E_sqeuclidean, E_euclidean)`` of the cells
``x``: ``2 mean d(x, y) - mean_{x != x'} d(x, x') - mean_{y != y'} d(y, y')``,
with ``d`` the squared Euclidean distance (scPerturb's default) and the
Euclidean distance (the energy distance of Szekely and Rizzo).
Precompute the reference's own mean distances.

The two E-statistics of ``cells`` against the reference.

:param cells: at least two cells by dimensions.
:returns: ``(E_sqeuclidean, E_euclidean)``.
spacr.gene_measurement_compare.EnergyTes:
Per-gene E-statistics and E-tests against non-targeting cells (item 917).

:param cells: the per-cell aligned embedding, cells by dimensions.
:param labels: each cell's gene; control cells start with ``control``.
:param guides: each cell's guide; the control guides with at least
    ``min_guide_cells`` cells are scored as their own rows.
:param control: the control prefix (case-sensitive).
:param n_ref: control cells in the fixed reference, drawn with
    ``default_rng(seed)``.
:param n_null: control pseudo-genes of the empirical null, drawn from
    the control cells outside the reference with
    ``default_rng(seed + 1 + n)``, ``n`` the null's cell count.
:param n_holdout: held-out control pseudo-genes, ``default_rng(seed + 2 + n)``,
    scored against the null: the false-positive rate.
:param seed: the base seed.
:param mode: ``'empirical_null'`` (the null above), ``'guide_null'``
    (pseudo-genes of four control guides, the shape of a gene: the
    control guides outside the reference are split in halves with
    ``default_rng(seed + 7)``; the null draws four guides of the first
    half and ``n`` cells of their union, ``default_rng(seed + 11 + n)``,
    and the held-out control does the same from the second half,
    ``default_rng(seed + 12 + n)``) or ``'permutation'`` (scPerturb's
    label permutation of the gene's cells and the reference,
    ``permutations`` times, ``default_rng(seed + 3)``).
:param permutations: label permutations per gene in permutation mode.
:param min_cells: genes with fewer cells after the cap are skipped.
:param min_guide_cells: the cells a control guide needs to be a row.

``score(n, subsample_seed)`` caps every gene and control guide at ``n``
cells (``default_rng(seed + 100 + subsample_seed)``, genes in sorted
order, then the control guides); ``n`` None keeps every cell and draws
the null at the median cells per gene.
Draw the reference and group the cells by gene and control guide.

The null and held-out E-statistics of ``n``-cell control pseudo-genes.

:param n: the pseudo-genes' cell count.
:returns: ``(null, holdout)``, each ``draws x 2`` (squared Euclidean,
    Euclidean).

E-statistics, p and q of every gene and control guide at a cap of ``n`` cells.

:param n: the cells-per-gene cap; None keeps every cell.
:param subsample_seed: the subsampling seed.
:returns: ``{"table", "summary"}``: ``table`` has ``gene``, ``cells``,
    ``e_sqeuclidean``, ``e_euclidean`` and, per metric, ``p_*`` and
    (genes only, BH over genes) ``q_*``; control guides are rows
    named ``NTguide_<guide>``. ``summary`` has one row per metric:
    genes, hits at q < 0.05, the held-out pseudo-genes' and control
    guides' shares at p < 0.05.
spacr.gene_measurement_compare.energy_di:
The E-statistic of two cell sets.

:param x: cells by dimensions.
:param y: cells by dimensions.
:param metric: ``'euclidean'`` (energy distance) or ``'sqeuclidean'``.
:returns: ``2 mean d(x, y) - mean_{x != x'} d(x, x') - mean_{y != y'} d(y, y')``.
:raises ValueError: for an unknown metric.

Per-gene E-distance and E-test against non-targeting cells.

:param cells: the per-cell aligned embedding, cells by dimensions.
:param labels: each cell's gene; control cells start with ``control``.
:param control: the control prefix.
:param n_ref: control cells in the fixed reference.
:param n_null: control pseudo-genes in the null.
:param seed: the base seed (see :class:`EnergyTest`).
:param guides: each cell's guide, for the control-guide rows; the
    labels when None.
:param n_cells: the cells-per-gene cap; None keeps every cell.
:param subsample_seed: the subsampling seed.
:param options: the other :class:`EnergyTest` options.
:returns: :meth:`EnergyTest.score`.
spacr.gene_measurement_compare.etest_pha:
The ``etest`` phase of the OPS profile path (item 917).

:param settings: read for ``ops_etest_cells`` (a folder with
    ``cells_E.npy``, the per-cell aligned embedding, and
    ``cells_meta.parquet`` with ``gene_symbol_0`` and
    ``cell_barcode_0``; ``cells_folder`` when empty),
    ``ops_etest_metric`` (``'both'``, ``'euclidean'`` or
    ``'sqeuclidean'``), ``ops_etest_reference_cells``,
    ``ops_etest_null``, ``ops_etest_holdout``, ``ops_etest_mode``,
    ``ops_etest_permutations``, ``ops_power_cells``,
    ``ops_power_seeds``, ``ops_power_retrieval``,
    ``ops_control_prefix`` and, for the retrieval curve,
    ``ops_reference_dir`` and the ``ops_eval_*`` settings.
:param cells_folder: the profile run folder, where the profile phase
    writes the embedding when ``ops_etest`` is on.
:param destination: ``dst_root``; outputs go to its
    ``results/ops_etest``.
:param report: called with progress lines.
:returns: ``{"folder", "outputs"}``.
:raises ValueError: when the embedding is missing or a setting is bad.
spacr.gene_measurement_compare.subsample:
A cells-per-gene power curve.

:param cells: the per-cell aligned embedding.
:param labels: each cell's gene.
:param ns: the caps; None is every cell, scored once with the first seed.
:param seeds: the subsampling seeds.
:param scorer: ``scorer(n, seed)`` returning ``{"table", "summary"}``;
    an :class:`EnergyTest` built from ``cells``, ``labels`` and
    ``options`` when None.
:param options: :class:`EnergyTest` options (``guides`` included).
:returns: ``{"tables": {(n, seed): table}, "hits": frame}``, the hits
    table holding every summary row in loop order.

Gene and guide medians from at most ``n`` cells per targeting gene.

:param embedding: the per-cell aligned embedding.
:param labels: each cell's gene; control cells start with ``control``
    and every control cell is kept.
:param guides: each cell's guide.
:param n: the cap.
:param seed: picks with ``default_rng(1000 * n + seed)``, genes in
    sorted order.
:param control: the control prefix.
:param min_cells: gene rows with this many cells or fewer are dropped,
    unless ``n`` is at most ``min_cells``, when rows of at least ``n``
    cells are kept.
:returns: ``(genes, guides)``: ``gene, n_cells, PC_*`` (control guides as
    ``<control>_<guide>`` rows, from the label) and ``guide, gene,
    n_cells, PC_*`` (control guides named by the label's suffix, gene
    ``control``), the medians in the embedding's precision.
spacr.ops_clusters.cluster_sweep_phase:
The ``cluster_sweep`` phase of the OPS profile path (item 916).

:param settings: read for ``ops_cluster_rows`` (a table of ready
    profile rows, ``gene`` plus numeric columns used as given; the
    profile phase's gene rows, embedded as the evaluate phase embeds
    them, when empty), ``ops_cluster_graph`` (``'phate'``, ``'knn'`` or
    both), ``ops_cluster_knn``, ``ops_cluster_sweep_resolutions``
    (``{graph: grid}``; :data:`SWEEP_RESOLUTIONS` for a graph not
    named), ``ops_cluster_seeds``, ``ops_cluster_target_clusters``,
    ``ops_cluster_shuffles``, ``ops_cluster_reference_dir`` (falling
    back to ``ops_reference_dir``), ``ops_cluster_gene_list`` (a table
    with a ``gene`` column; every targeting row when empty),
    ``ops_profile_min_cells`` and ``ops_control_prefix``.
:param genes: the profile phase's gene table, or None.
:param folder: ``dst_root``; outputs go to its
    ``results/ops_clusters``.
:param report: called with progress lines.
:returns: ``{"folder", "outputs", "rows", "graphs"}``.
:raises ValueError: when no rows or no reference folder are given, or a
    graph is unknown.
:raises ImportError: when the ``clustering`` extra is not installed.
spacr.ops_clusters.complex_metrics:
Complex recovery and partner-in-cluster share of one clustering.

:param genes: the scored genes.
:param labels: one cluster label per gene.
:param groups: ``{complex: members}`` (CORUM).
:param halves: ``{complex: 0 or 1}``; complexes of half 1 (REPORT) are
    scored for recovery.
:returns: ``REPORT_complexes`` (REPORT complexes with at least three
    scored members), ``complexes_recovered_pct`` (those with at least
    half their scored members in one cluster) and
    ``CORUM_partner_in_cluster_pct`` (genes with a CORUM partner among
    the scored genes, of any half, that share its cluster).
spacr.ops_clusters.gene_graph:
The gene graph a Leiden sweep clusters.

:param rows: one profile row per gene (controls included).
:param kind: ``'phate'``, PHATE's diffusion operator (``knn`` cosine
    neighbours) made symmetric, ``(P + P.T) / 2``; or ``'knn'``, the
    union of every row's ``k`` nearest rows by cosine, each edge weighted
    by its cosine clipped at 1e-6.
:param k: the neighbours of the ``'knn'`` graph.
:param seed: PHATE's seed; the ``'knn'`` graph has none.
:param knn: PHATE's neighbours.
:param n_jobs: PHATE's worker count.
:returns: an undirected, weighted ``igraph.Graph``, one vertex per row.
:raises ImportError: when the ``clustering`` extra is not installed.
:raises ValueError: for an unknown ``kind``.
spacr.ops_clusters.leiden_partitions:
Leiden partitions of one graph for every seed and resolution.

:param graph: from :func:`gene_graph`.
:param resolutions: Leiden resolution parameters.
:param seeds: Leiden seeds.
:returns: ``{(seed, resolution): labels}`` in seed-then-resolution order;
    each partition optimises the RB configuration model with
    ``n_iterations=-1`` (until it stops improving).
:raises ImportError: when the ``clustering`` extra is not installed.
spacr.ops_clusters.score_partition:
One sweep row: :func:`score_clusters` plus :func:`complex_metrics`.

:param name: the row's label.
:param genes: the scored genes.
:param labels: their cluster labels.
:param refs: from :func:`sweep_references`.
:returns: the row; ``STRING_f1`` is computed from the rounded precision
    and recall, as the sweep reports them.
spacr.ops_clusters.score_partitions:
Score every partition and its shuffled-label controls.

:param names: the clustered row names, in the partitions' row order.
:param partitions: ``{(graph, seed, resolution): labels}``, scored in
    this order.
:param refs: from :func:`sweep_references`.
:param shuffles: shuffled-label controls per partition: the scored
    genes' labels permuted, cluster sizes kept.
:param seed: the controls' seed; one generator draws them in loop order.
:param genes: the genes scored; every non-control row when None.
:param label: the ``profile`` of every row.
:param report: called with one progress line per partition.
:returns: one row per partition (``control`` ``'real'``) and per
    control (``'shuffled gene labels'``), with ``graph``, ``seed`` and
    ``resolution``.
:raises KeyError: when a gene of ``genes`` is not a row.
spacr.ops_clusters.sweep_references:
The reference tables a resolution sweep scores against.

:param reference_dir: the folder (or folders) holding Brieflow's
    ``corum_group_benchmark.tsv``, ``kegg_group_benchmark.tsv`` and
    ``string_pair_benchmark.tsv``.
:returns: ``corum`` and ``kegg`` (group tables), ``positives`` (the
    STRING pairs), ``groups`` (CORUM complexes) and ``halves`` (each
    complex's half, :func:`spacr.ops_reference.group_halves`).
spacr.ops_clusters.sweep_summary:
Mean, minimum and maximum of every sweep metric over the seeds.

:param rows: from :func:`score_partitions`.
:param target: the cluster count to flag.
:returns: one row per graph, resolution and control, with
    ``<metric> mean|min|max`` columns and ``nearest_<target>`` True on
    each graph's real resolution whose mean cluster count is nearest
    ``target`` (the first on a tie).
spacr.ops_decode.nuclei_with_read:
How many of a field's owned nuclei have at least one read (item 915).

:param evidence: one field's decode evidence (:func:`field_evidence` or
    its cache): ``strength``, ``id0``, ``owned0`` and ``owned_ids``.
:param threshold: the read threshold; a spot is a read when its
    strength is above it.
:returns: the owned nuclei whose territory holds a read: spots above the
    threshold attributed to a nucleus (``id0`` at least 0) that the
    field owns.
spacr.ops_flatfield.build_nuclear_flat:
One plate's nuclear-median flat-field map from its per-nucleus table.

:param nuclei: one row per nucleus with ``well``, ``site``, ``cy``,
    ``cx`` and ``column``, measured with no flat-field applied.
:param column: the nuclear mean intensity of the channel.
:param offset: the plate's camera offset of the channel; required.
:param holdout: ``(well, site)`` fields left out of the build, for
    :func:`validate_nuclear_flat`.
:param cy: the centroid row column.
:param cx: the centroid column column.
:param block: field pixels per map cell.
:param size: map cells per axis; ``field_px // block`` when None.
:param fit: see :func:`fit_nuclear_flat`.
:param sigma_px: see :func:`fit_nuclear_flat`.
:param ridge: see :func:`fit_nuclear_flat`.
:param floor: see :func:`fit_nuclear_flat`.
:param centre_cells: see :func:`fit_nuclear_flat`.
:param map_grid: see :func:`fit_nuclear_flat`.
:param field_px: field pixels per axis; from the largest centroid
    rounded up to whole blocks when None.
:param centre_offset: see :func:`fit_nuclear_flat`.
:param lookup: how the map is to be read, recorded with it
    (:func:`flat_to_field`).
:returns: ``(flat, info)``: the float32 map and its record (offset,
    floor, held-out fields, training and held-out nuclei, nuclei per
    cell, centre value, corner mean, percent of cells at the floor,
    fit, sigma, grid, lookup and package versions).
:raises ValueError: for a missing offset, column or nucleus.
spacr.ops_flatfield.field_nucleus_means:
Per nucleus of one field: raw mean, mean gain and exact corrected mean.

:param image: the field's raw intensities of the channel.
:param nuclei: its nucleus labels.
:param maps: ``{name: (h, w) flat}`` to compare.
:param offset: the camera offset ``b``.
:param lookups: ``{name: {"lookup", "block", "centre_offset"}}``;
    zoom when a name is missing.
:returns: a frame with ``label``, ``raw_mean`` and per map ``g_<name>``
    (the mean of ``1 / F`` over the nucleus, the analytic gain) and
    ``exact_<name>`` (the mean of ``(I - b) / F + b``, the exact
    correction), F the map read at the field's pixels.
spacr.ops_flatfield.fit_nuclear_flat:
A flat-field map from per-cell nuclear medians (item 912).

:param median: per map cell, the median nuclear intensity
    (:func:`nuclear_median_grid`); NaN where empty.
:param count: per map cell, the nuclei behind the median; the weight.
:param offset: the camera offset ``b`` of the channel and plate.
:param fit: ``'local_quadratic_log'`` (default): per cell, a weighted
    least-squares fit of ``log(clip(median - b, 1))`` on
    ``1, x, y, x^2, xy, y^2`` with weights count times a Gaussian of
    ``sigma_px``; ``'local_linear'``: the same with a plane on the
    medians themselves; ``'gaussian'``: the count-weighted Gaussian
    mean of the medians, empty reach filled from the nearest cell.
:param sigma_px: the Gaussian sigma in field pixels (32 = 2 cells).
:param block: field pixels per map cell.
:param ridge: added to each local normal-equation system; None takes
    1e-6 for the quadratic and 1e-9 for the plane.
:param floor: the smallest map value.
:param centre_cells: the central square normalised to 1.
:param map_grid: ``'block_centre'`` evaluates each cell's fit at the
    cell itself; ``'lookup'`` at the field position the zoom lookup
    reads the cell from (:func:`lookup_positions`), with the
    coefficients of the nearest cell, so a map read by zoom is right
    where the fall is steepest. Local fits only.
:param field_px: field pixels along each axis, for ``'lookup'``;
    ``size * block`` when None.
:param centre_offset: field-pixel offset of a cell's centre.
:returns: ``(flat, info)``: the float32 map and ``{"centre",
    "filled_cells", "ridge"}``.
:raises ValueError: for an unknown fit or grid, or ``'lookup'`` with
    the Gaussian fit.
spacr.ops_flatfield.flat_lookups:
How each channel's map in a ``flat_info.json`` record is read.

:param info: the record :func:`load_flat_maps` returns, or None.
:returns: ``{channel: {"lookup", "block", "centre_offset"}}`` for the
    channels whose method names a lookup; a map recorded without one
    (every map before item 912) is read by zoom and is left out.
spacr.ops_flatfield.flat_to_field:
One map read at every field pixel, bilinearly.

:param flat: the ``(h, w)`` map.
:param shape: ``(H, W)`` of the field.
:param lookup: ``'zoom_endpoints'`` is ``scipy.ndimage.zoom`` (map
    pixel ``i`` at field pixel ``i * (H - 1) / (h - 1)``), how every map
    before item 912 was read; ``'block_centre'`` puts map pixel ``i``
    at field pixel ``block * i + centre_offset``, the centre of the
    block it was measured on, and holds the edge value beyond the
    outermost centres.
:param block: field pixels per map pixel.
:param centre_offset: field-pixel offset of a block's centre; 8 is the
    convention the maps of item 912 are built with, 7.5 the centre of
    pixels ``16 i .. 16 i + 15`` that Measure's illumination surface
    uses.
:returns: the ``(H, W)`` plane, in the map's dtype for
    ``'zoom_endpoints'`` and float64 for ``'block_centre'``.
:raises ValueError: for an unknown lookup.
spacr.ops_flatfield.holdout_fields:
Fields kept out of a nuclear map's build, the same number per well.

:param fields: every ``(well, site)`` with nuclei.
:param count: how many to hold out, split evenly over the wells
    (``count // wells`` each, at least one).
:param seed: the seed of :func:`numpy.random.default_rng`, drawn once
    per well in sorted well order.
:returns: the chosen ``(well, site)``, sorted.
spacr.ops_flatfield.lookup_positions:
Where the zoom lookup reads each map pixel, in map-cell units.

:param size: map pixels along the axis.
:param field_px: field pixels along the axis.
:param block: field pixels per map cell.
:param centre_offset: field-pixel offset of a cell's centre.
:returns: ``(i * (field_px - 1) / (size - 1) - centre_offset) / block``
    for every map pixel ``i``: ``scipy.ndimage.zoom`` puts map pixel
    ``i`` at field pixel ``i * (field_px - 1) / (size - 1)``, which on
    a 185-cell map of a 2,960 px field is up to 8 px past the centre of
    the cell it was measured on.
spacr.ops_flatfield.normalise_flat:
A smooth surface as a flat-field map: 1 at the centre, floored.

:param surface: the fitted surface on the camera's scale.
:param offset: the camera offset ``b``.
:param floor: the smallest map value, so the gain is at most
    ``1 / floor``.
:param centre_cells: the edge, in map cells, of the central square
    whose mean is 1 after normalising.
:returns: ``(flat, centre)``: ``clip((surface - b) / (centre - b),
    floor)`` and the centre's mean on the camera's scale.
spacr.ops_flatfield.nuclear_median_grid:
Per map cell, the median of the nuclei's values and how many there are.

:param cy: nucleus centroid rows, in field pixels.
:param cx: nucleus centroid columns.
:param values: one value per nucleus, such as its mean DNA intensity
    with no flat-field applied.
:param block: field pixels per map cell along each axis.
:param size: map cells along each axis; a centroid past the last cell
    counts in it.
:returns: ``(median, count)``, two ``(size, size)`` float64 arrays;
    ``median`` is NaN where no nucleus fell.

A nucleus is bright where the light is and its own size, so the median
over the nuclei of a cell follows the illumination, while the pixel
median of a DNA image is mostly background between nuclei and falls
less steeply toward the corners. Non-finite values are left out.
spacr.ops_flatfield.nucleus_table:
One plate's per-nucleus table for the nuclear-median map.

:param settings: read for ``ops_flatfield_nuclei`` (a table, a folder of
    per-well tables, or ``{plate: either}``) and ``dst_root``.
:param plate: the plate.
:param channel: the nuclear channel.
:returns: one row per nucleus with ``well``, ``site``, ``label``,
    ``nucleus_cy``, ``nucleus_cx`` and the channel's nuclear mean.
    With no ``ops_flatfield_nuclei``, the run's own tables are joined
    on ``site`` and ``label``: the mask pass (``ops_maskpass_<well>``,
    centroids and stored gains) and the measured cells
    (``ops_phenotype_cells_<well>``, measured with no flat applied).
:raises ValueError: when no table is found or a column is missing.
spacr.ops_flatfield.radial_table:
Median corrected value per radius ring over the centre ring, with CIs.

:param frame: one row per held-out nucleus with ``field``, ``cy``,
    ``cx`` and one column per version (as measured, analytic and
    exact per map).
:param versions: the version columns.
:param centre: the field centre ``(row, col)`` in pixels.
:param edges: the ring edges in pixels.
:param bootstrap: field bootstraps for the 95 % intervals.
:param seed: the bootstrap seed of :func:`numpy.random.default_rng`.
:param min_bin_cells: rings with fewer nuclei are not scored in the
    summary.
:returns: ``(table, summary)``: one row per ring and version
    (``radius_bin``, ``n_cells``, ``n_fields``, ``version``,
    ``median_over_centre``, ``ci_lo``, ``ci_hi``, rounded to 4
    decimals) and per version the largest ring deviation from 1 over
    rings with ``min_bin_cells`` nuclei and the median beyond 1,800 px
    over the median within 500 px.
spacr.ops_flatfield.record_flat_md5:
Keep the md5 of the maps a run used, and refuse a changed map.

:param run_folder: the run's ``dst_root``.
:param info: the record :func:`load_flat_maps` returns.
:returns: the record written or found, or None for maps written before
    item 912 (no ``md5_record`` flag), which are left as they were.
:raises ValueError: when ``illumination_md5.json`` already names a
    different md5 for a channel; the message gives both.
spacr.ops_flatfield.run_flat_phases:
Build and check per-plate nuclear-median flat-field maps (item 912).

``flat_nuclear`` builds each plate's map from its per-nucleus table
(:func:`nucleus_table`, :func:`build_nuclear_flat`), leaving the
held-out fields out, and writes it with its sidecar record into a new
folder (:func:`write_nuclear_flat`) that also carries the plate's other
channel maps from ``ops_flatfield_maps``; point ``ops_flatfield_maps``
at that folder to use it. ``flat_validate`` re-measures the held-out
nuclei exactly and analytically with the new map and the earlier one
(:func:`validate_nuclear_flat`) and writes the radial table.

:param settings: the OPS settings. Read here: ``plate`` (one plate or a
    comma-separated list), ``dst_root``, ``ops_flatfield_nuclear_channel``
    (required), ``ops_flatfield_nuclei``, ``ops_flatfield_dark``,
    ``ops_flatfield_maps``, ``ops_flatfield_nuclear_maps``, the fit
    settings ``ops_flatfield_block_px``, ``ops_flatfield_fit``,
    ``ops_flatfield_sigma_px``, ``ops_flatfield_ridge``,
    ``ops_flatfield_floor``, ``ops_flatfield_centre_cells``,
    ``ops_flatfield_map_grid``, ``ops_flatfield_field_px``,
    ``ops_flatfield_centre_offset``, ``ops_flatfield_lookup``, the hold-out
    ``ops_flatfield_holdout_fields``, ``ops_flatfield_holdout_n``,
    ``ops_flatfield_seed``, and for the check
    ``ops_flatfield_holdout_images`` (a folder, or ``{plate: folder}``,
    of ``*<well>_<site>.npy`` raw images of the channel),
    ``ops_flatfield_holdout_masks`` (the run folder holding
    ``<well>/phenotype_masks/site-<n>.npz``; ``dst_root`` when empty),
    ``ops_flatfield_compare_maps`` (``{name: .npy}`` read by zoom),
    ``ops_flatfield_radial_edges``, ``ops_flatfield_bootstrap``,
    ``ops_flatfield_bootstrap_seed`` and ``ops_flatfield_min_bin_cells``.
:param phases: ``"flat_nuclear"``, ``"flat_validate"`` or both.
:param report: called with progress lines.
:returns: ``{"plates": {plate: {"folder", "md5", ...}}}``.
:raises ValueError: for a missing channel, offset or table.
spacr.ops_flatfield.validate_nuclear_fla:
Held-out check of flat-field maps by exact re-measurement.

:param nuclei: the per-nucleus table (``well``, ``site``, ``label``,
    ``cy``, ``cx``, ``column``).
:param fields: ``{(well, site): (raw image, nucleus labels)}`` of the
    held-out fields; they must not have been used to build the maps.
:param maps: ``{name: flat}``, the new map and any earlier ones.
:param column: the run's nuclear mean of the channel, no flat applied.
:param offset: the camera offset ``b``.
:param lookups: see :func:`field_nucleus_means`.
:param gain_column: the run's stored gain of the first map, checked
    against the recomputed one.
:param cy: the centroid row column.
:param cx: the centroid column column.
:param edges: see :func:`radial_table`.
:param bootstrap: see :func:`radial_table`.
:param seed: see :func:`radial_table`.
:param min_bin_cells: see :func:`radial_table`.
:param centre: the field centre; the image centre when None.
:returns: ``(cells, table, summary)``: per held-out nucleus the run
    value, analytic ``(v - b) g + b`` and exact values per map; the
    radial table; and the summary with sanity rows (raw mean vs run
    value correlation and median relative difference, and the largest
    difference between recomputed and stored gains).
:raises ValueError: when a field has no nucleus in the table.
spacr.ops_flatfield.write_nuclear_flat:
Write a nuclear map as a complete, never-overwritten maps folder.

:param folder: the new folder; it must not hold maps yet.
:param plate: the plate name used in file names.
:param channel: the channel the map corrects.
:param flat: the map.
:param info: its record from :func:`build_nuclear_flat`; also written
    next to the map as ``flat_<plate>_<CH>.json``.
:param base: a maps folder (:func:`write_flat_maps`) whose other
    channels are copied byte for byte, so the new folder replaces it.
:returns: the folder's ``flat_info.json`` record. Its ``md5_record``
    flag makes every run that uses these maps keep their md5 in
    ``illumination_md5.json`` (:func:`record_flat_md5`).
:raises FileExistsError: when ``folder`` already holds maps.
spacr.ops_mitotic.mitotic_index_table:
Per-gene mitotic index tested against the non-targeting cells (item 914).

:param cells: one row per genotyped cell with ``gene``, ``sgRNA`` and
    the boolean ``call`` (and ``rule``, a second call compared alongside).
:param call: the column of the mitotic call tested.
:param rule: a second call column reported as ``rule_index``, or None.
:param reference: a published per-gene mitotic index
    (:func:`published_mitotic_index`) for the agreement rows, or None.
:param min_cells: genes with fewer cells are left out of the agreement.
:param shuffles: gene-label shuffles of the agreement control.
:param seed: the shuffle seed of :func:`numpy.random.default_rng`.
:param control_prefix: genes starting with it (any case) are the
    controls.
:returns: ``(per_gene, nt_guides, summary)``. Per gene: ``cells``,
    ``mitotic``, ``mitotic_index``, the two-sided exact binomial ``p``
    against the pooled control rate, ``z`` and BH ``q`` (genes only),
    sorted by ``z``; per control guide the same without ``q``, the
    control. The summary has the control rate, the genes at q < 0.05
    up and down, the share of control guides at p < 0.05, and with a
    reference Spearman rho of each call against it with the 95th
    percentile of ``|rho|`` over the shuffles.
spacr.ops_mitotic.published_mitotic_inde:
Per-gene mitotic index of a published table with per-guide cell counts.

:param table: one row per gene with ``gene_symbol`` and
    ``sgRNA_<k>_mitotic_cells`` / ``sgRNA_<k>_interphase_cells`` for
    ``k = 1 .. guides`` (Funk et al. 2022's gene table); duplicate genes
    keep the first row.
:param guides: the guides per gene.
:returns: mitotic / (mitotic + interphase) cells summed over the
    guides, indexed by gene.
spacr.ops_scoring:
Shared community-standard scoring of OPS gene profiles and clusterings (item 913).

Gene-level results of different analyses of one screen (spaCR, Brieflow,
the published Funk et al. 2022 tables) are only comparable when the same
scoring code is applied to the same genes. This module applies the field's
two reference packages, unchanged, to every analysis at once:

* copairs (Kalinin et al. 2025): phenotypic ACTIVITY, the mAP of each gene's
  guides retrieving each other against the non-targeting guides, and
  phenotypic CONSISTENCY, the mAP of each CORUM complex and of each gene's
  reference partners;
* efaar_benchmarking (Celik et al. 2024): RECALL of known gene relationships
  in the outer tails of all gene-pair cosines.

What each input can be scored on is stated, never dropped: activity needs
guide-level profiles, profile-level consistency and EFAAR need one profile
per gene, and an analysis that published only clusters is scored on its
clusters, as one-hot rows. Every metric comes with its controls: shuffled
gene labels, non-targeting pseudo-genes, and non-targeting pseudo-complexes.

The packages are an optional extra (``spacr[scoring]``), pinned and never
vendored; copairs' null cache goes to the run folder.
spacr.ops_scoring.activity_map:
copairs phenotypic activity of every gene's guides against the controls.

:param features: one row per guide.
:param gene: the gene label of each row (``"NT"`` for controls).
:param is_control: True for the control rows.
:param tag: the ``set`` the rows are labelled with.
:param null_size: permutations of the null per configuration.
:param workers: copairs worker threads.
:param cache_dir: copairs' null cache.
:returns: ``(ap, map)``: per-guide AP and per-gene mAP with p, BH q and
    the flags at 0.05; ``assign_reference_index`` on the controls,
    ``pos_sameby=[gene, reference]``, ``neg_diffby=[ctrl]``, cosine,
    ``mean_average_precision(seed=0)``.
spacr.ops_scoring.complex_map:
copairs multilabel consistency mAP of every complex.

:param features: one row per gene (and control rows).
:param complexes: ``{complex: row indices}``.
:param tag: the representation name (``rep``).
:param seed: the null seed.
:param null_size: see :func:`activity_map`.
:param workers: see :func:`activity_map`.
:param cache_dir: see :func:`activity_map`.
:returns: per complex the mAP, p, q, flags, ``rep`` and ``n_members``.
spacr.ops_scoring.efaar_tails:
Per known pair of one EFAAR source: in the outer tails at each threshold.

:param X: one row per gene.
:param genes: the gene names.
:param source: an EFAAR benchmark source.
:returns: ``{"lo_hi": bool per pair}``, EFAAR's ``compute_recall`` kept
    per pair, for the paired tests.
spacr.ops_scoring.is_nt:
True for non-targeting rows and the pseudo-genes made from them.

:param names: gene or row names.
:returns: a boolean array; names starting with ``nontargeting`` or
    ``ntpseudo`` in any case.
spacr.ops_scoring.load_scoring_inputs:
Read every analysis to score and restrict it to the shared genes.

:param inputs: ``{name: {"genes": path, "guides": path, "clusters":
    path}}``, any subset per name. A gene table has ``gene`` and numeric
    profile columns (non-targeting rows named ``nontargeting*`` are kept
    as controls); a guide table has ``gene`` and numeric columns
    (``guide`` and ``n_cells`` are not features); a cluster table has
    ``gene`` and ``cluster``.
:param genes: the shared genes in order; the sorted intersection of the
    targeting genes of every input when None.
:returns: ``{"genes", "profiles": {name: (rows, nt_names)},
    "guides": {name: (rows, gene)}, "clusters": {name: labels}}``;
    profile rows are the shared genes in order then the control rows in
    file order, guide rows those of shared genes and controls in file
    order.
:raises ValueError: when an input lacks a shared gene or a column.
spacr.ops_scoring.onehot_rows:
Cluster labels as one-hot rows plus a little Gaussian noise.

:param labels: one cluster label per gene.
:param seed: the noise seed of :func:`numpy.random.default_rng`.
:param eps: the noise sd; 0 gives exact one-hot rows, whose cosine is
    exactly 1 within and 0 between clusters.
:returns: float32 rows. With noise, cosine is about 1 within and 0
    between clusters and ties are broken at random, so copairs scores
    are averaged over several seeds.
spacr.ops_scoring.pair_ap:
Per-gene AP of retrieving its reference partners, with copairs' kernels.

:param features: one row per gene.
:param positives: the boolean partner matrix.
:param tag: the representation name.
:param seed: the null seed.
:param null_size: null draws per ``(positives, total)`` configuration.
:param cache_dir: copairs' null cache.
:returns: per query gene ``gene_idx``, ``ap``, ``n_pos``, ``n_total``,
    ``random_ap``, ``p`` and BH ``q``. Queries and candidates are the
    genes with at least one partner; ties keep row order.
spacr.ops_scoring.pair_summary:
Partner retrieval per reference, representation, control and seed.

:param pairs: :func:`score_consistency`'s per-gene table.
:returns: genes, mAP, random mAP and the share of genes at q < 0.05.
spacr.ops_scoring.reference_complexes:
CORUM complexes of one selection half with enough shared genes.

:param genes: the shared genes in row order.
:param reference_dir: the folder of the references
    (:mod:`spacr.ops_reference`).
:param half: ``'SELECT'`` or ``'REPORT'``.
:param min_members: the fewest member rows a complex needs.
:returns: ``{complex: sorted row indices}``.
spacr.ops_scoring.scorability_table:
Which input can be scored on which metric, and why not.

:param data: :func:`load_scoring_inputs` output.
:param names: the input names.
:returns: one row per input, level and metric with ``scorable``
    ("yes" or "not scorable") and ``reason``.
spacr.ops_scoring.score_activity:
Activity of real genes with its two controls, as one table.

:param features: one row per guide.
:param gene: each guide's gene; controls start with ``nontargeting``.
:param null_size: see :func:`activity_map`.
:param workers: see :func:`activity_map`.
:param cache_dir: see :func:`activity_map`.
:param label: the set name of the real genes.
:param nt_seeds: one NT pseudo-gene control per seed: half the control
    guides, permuted, in fours, scored against the other half.
:param shuffle_seed: the targeting guides' gene labels permuted (group
    sizes kept) and scored against the same controls.
:returns: the per-gene mAP rows of every set.
spacr.ops_scoring.score_consistency:
Complex and partner consistency of every representation, with controls.

:param data: :func:`load_scoring_inputs` output.
:param reference_dir: the reference folder.
:param references: the pair references of the per-gene retrieval, such
    as ``CORUM@REPORT`` and ``STRING>=0.7@REPORT``.
:param min_members: the fewest shared genes of a REPORT-half complex.
:param null_size: see :func:`activity_map`.
:param workers: see :func:`activity_map`.
:param cluster_seeds: noise seeds of the one-hot cluster rows.
:param jitter: the noise sd of the cluster rows.
:param shuffle_seed: the gene-label permutation of the shuffled control.
:param complex_seeds: seeds of the NT pseudo-complexes (control rows
    grouped like the real complexes' sizes).
:param pair_seeds: seeds of the NT pseudo-genes of partner retrieval (a
    control row takes a real gene's partner list).
:param cache_dir: copairs' null cache.
:returns: ``(complex_map, pairs_per_gene, setup)``.
spacr.ops_scoring.score_efaar:
EFAAR known-relationship recall of every representation, with controls.

:param data: :func:`load_scoring_inputs` output.
:param shuffle_seeds: one shuffled-label run per seed.
:param nt_seeds: one NT pseudo-gene control per seed: each known pair
    ``(a, b)`` becomes ``(control row, b)``, against the same all-gene
    null (profiles only).
:returns: ``(recall_all, recall_summary, mcnemar)``. Clusters are exact
    one-hot rows, so their high tail is exactly the co-clustered pairs;
    compare clusters with clusters only. McNemar pairs every two
    profiles and every two clusterings on the same known pairs.
spacr.ops_scoring.score_ops_profiles:
Score OPS gene profiles and clusterings with copairs and EFAAR (item 913).

:param settings: read for ``ops_scoring_inputs`` (``{name: {"genes",
    "guides", "clusters", "pvalues", "cell_counts": path}}``; the last
    two serve item 923's hit rule), ``ops_scoring_metrics`` (empty runs
    the item-913 metrics ``activity``, ``consistency`` and ``efaar``;
    listing ``corum_within_r``, ``string_auprc`` or ``hits_mw_ztpm``
    adds :func:`score_profile_benchmarks`, and a list of only those
    skips the copairs and EFAAR scoring), ``ops_scoring_genes`` (a table with
    ``gene``, or a list; the intersection of the inputs when empty),
    ``ops_scoring_null_size``, ``ops_scoring_min_complex``,
    ``ops_scoring_references``, ``ops_scoring_cluster_jitter``,
    ``ops_scoring_cluster_seeds``, ``ops_scoring_controls`` (False
    skips the shuffled and NT controls), ``ops_scoring_workers``,
    ``ops_scoring_figures``, ``ops_reference_dir`` and ``dst_root``.
:param report: called with progress lines.
:returns: ``{"folder", "outputs"}``; everything is written to
    ``<dst_root>/ops_scoring``: ``scorable.csv``, ``activity_map.csv``,
    ``consistency_complex_map.csv``, ``consistency_pairs_pergene.csv.gz``,
    ``consistency_pairs_summary_by_seed.csv``, ``efaar_recall_all.csv``,
    ``efaar_recall_summary.csv``, ``efaar_mcnemar.csv``,
    ``summary_main.csv``, ``stats.json``, ``setup.json`` and two figures.
:raises ValueError: for missing inputs, ``dst_root`` or references.
spacr.ops_scoring.summary_and_stats:
The main summary table and the paired tests, Holm within each panel.

:param data: :func:`load_scoring_inputs` output.
:param activity: the activity table, or None when no input has guides.
:param complexes: the complex table.
:param pairs: the per-gene partner table.
:param efaar: the EFAAR recall table.
:param references: the partner references.
:param mcnemar: :func:`score_efaar`'s paired tests; with them the
    10 % / 90 % profile tests get their own panel, Holm over the sources.
:returns: ``(summary, stats)``. Activity: Fisher exact of active counts
    against each control. Complexes: exact McNemar over the same
    complexes (seed 0). Partners: paired Wilcoxon over the same genes.
    EFAAR: exact McNemar over the same known pairs (5 % / 95 % tails),
    per source for profiles and on the union of sources for clusters.
spacr.ops_tvn.cell_states:
The cell states ``ops_profile_cell_state`` asks for, checked.

:param value: one state, a comma-separated string or a list; empty is
    ``'interphase_rule'``.
:returns: the states in the order given.
:raises ValueError: for an unknown state.
spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo.ModelZooScree:
Read the catalogue the first time the screen is shown.

Nothing listed the models when the screen opened: only Scan, or
turning on a heading that fetches (community, bioimage.io), started
a read. A heading such as spaCR only folds rows, so with spaCR alone
on the list stayed empty until the community confirmation was
answered. The read is queued, not run here, so the window paints
first and shows the loading note.

:param event: the show event, passed on to the base class.
